sections.heading: Every hero needs support.
sections.lead: Two products, designed as one routine. Twenty ingredients between them, every amount published.

image.alt: The Saede Hero capsule jar with its brushed gold lid, beside the Saede Support powder pouch, on a soft cream background.

sections.caption: Saede Hero · Saede Support · made in the EU

sections.heading: Because one format cannot carry all of it.
paragraphs: The root-cause botanicals and the micronutrients belong in a capsule: a precise, stable, measured dose you swallow in seconds without tasting anything.

The collagen and the inositols do not fit in a capsule. Not because of formulation cleverness — because of arithmetic. Our collagen is 5 g and our myo-inositol is 4 g. That is nine grams from two ingredients alone.

image.alt: The Saede duo photographed on pale silk, light falling across the folds behind them.

items: A capsule holds milligrams. A scoop holds grams.
To deliver 9 g in capsules you would swallow a fistful a day
So most brands quietly shrink the dose to whatever fits — and still put the ingredient on the front of the box
We would rather give you a powder and tell you why

sections.heading: How to take it.
paragraphs: **{{hero}}** — one capsule a day, with food. Taking it with a meal helps absorption and is gentler on the stomach.

**{{partner}}** — one scoop a day, stirred into whatever you already have. Coffee, water, juice, a smoothie. Sonja puts hers in yogurt. It dissolves easily and is gentle to digest, so it fits into your morning rather than becoming another task.
Whenever you will actually remember is the right time. Consistency over six months beats perfect timing over three weeks, every time.

sections.heading: Both, every 28 days.
paragraphs: The duo is designed to be taken together, which is how membership delivers it.
